_about: Allow-list + size rules for tools/ui-qa/component-audit.mjs (2026-10-18). Extend here, not in the tool. Every class documented in the Component Inventory of .claude/skills/components.md is ALSO accepted (tier „documented”) — the lists below name the library primitives and the product component roots that wrap native controls.
_library: library primitives (css/main.css, Components/*.html). A control matches when it, or an ancestor up to `ancestorDepth`, matches one of these.
_product: product component roots that wrap native controls (documented in components.md; listed so ancestor matching works). A native <input>/<button> inside one of these, up to `ancestorDepth` levels, is the product component. `.sm-table` removed 2026-10-21 (its inventory row is struck through — the table was replaced by the request rows).
_copy: Copy value — ONE component (2026-10-20, user: „the copy code is different, use the same everywhere as a component”; 2026-10-21: „tables or stacked lists: no copy icon, but the behaviour is the same”). copy-variant (major): any copy markup that is not .copy-value (legacy classes / data hooks, or an icon-only button labelled „Copiază…”). copy-in-list (major): a DEFAULT .copy-value (with its icon) inside a list view — lists use .copy-value--compact; listExempt = documented exceptions. missing-copy (major): a plain-text copy candidate (candidates) inside a list view.

copy._candidates: plain-text numbers that must be the compact copy value in a list view (whole text node): dossier / act / request / session numbers (D-2026-004575, GEAP-2026-009-04588, LIC-2024-1876, P-8991/2026, KYC-48192) and 13-digit IDNO / IDNP. Masked values (•) never match.

_ignoreWithin: prototype-only tools and third-party widgets — never audited `[class*='__scrim']` = drawer backdrops (click-to-close layer, not a control — report 2026-10-21 R016).
_fieldBoxes: elements whose rendered box IS a form field (height / text / icons are measured on it). Native fields are measured on their first painted box (themselves or a wrapper up to 3 levels).
_fieldText: the element whose font-size is the field text (first match inside the box, else the box)
_sizeExempt: fields that are deliberately another size (documented exceptions) — reported as info only

desktop._text: desktop field text is not checked (library medium = body-sm 14, FO 14)

lookAlike._about: an element that is styled as a control but has no control role and no library / documented class

_backNav: Back navigation — ONE component (2026-10-21, user: „let's use the breadcrumb as a component … why invent it?”, Figma Components 232:5282). crumb-trail (major): an element with a `crumb` class (or a breadcrumb nav) that is not, and does not hold, the library .breadcrumbs. back-link (major): a link / button outside .breadcrumbs whose text or aria-label starts with „Înapoi la” / „‹” / „←”, or that carries a `-back` / `__back` / `back-shell` / `back-link` class or data hook. exempt = step navigation inside wizards / dialogs (FO step footer, drawer and modal footers, „Schimbă”), empty-state actions, the RAP logo link and the MPass test page.
_tooltip: Tooltips (rule 8, tooltip-one-v1, 2026-10-21, user: „do as you recommend” on the audit's ONE tooltip runtime). tooltip-private (major): a visible element whose class names a tooltip and is not the library .tooltip (js/icon-tooltip.js, #icon-tooltip) or the copy-value tooltip. tooltip-title (major): a native title= on an interactive element — the plain tooltip reads aria-label / data-tooltip-label, cut text = data-cell-tooltip, extra information = data-tooltip-text / -hint. titleExempt: iframes (title = the accessible name, not a tooltip).

tooltip.interactive: button, a[href], [role=button], [role=link], [role=tab], [role=menuitem], [role=option], [role=switch], [role=checkbox], [role=radio], input, select, textarea, summary, [tabindex]:not([tabindex='-1'])

_drawer: Drawer (rule 9, drawer-v1, 2026-10-21): ONE right-hand panel = .drawer-overlay > aside.drawer (css/drawer.css + js/drawer.js; sizes default 800 / --lg 960; phones = the shared sheet). drawer-private (major): a visible dialog / aside that is a full-height panel on the right edge, or whose class names a drawer, and is not .drawer. allow = intentionally different surfaces: the library modal and bottom sheet, the Ghișeu full-screen request sheet, the template / notification editor sheets (.e-permits-ntpl-sheet), the Form Builder / Process Designer full-screen editors.
_skeleton: Skeleton (rule 10, skeleton-v1, 2026-10-21): ONE loading placeholder = .skeleton + --text / --input / --block / --circle (css/skeleton.css; size from the slot, base tertiary + shimmer, none for reduced motion). skeleton-private (major): a visible element whose class names a skeleton / shimmer / placeholder shape and paints one (gradient background or a running animation) without .skeleton. Containers (page-step-skeleton, page-auth-skeleton…) paint nothing and pass.
_actionIcons: Action icons (rule 6, 2026-10-21, user: „didn't we discuss that every Editează has an edit icon, and Elimină a trash icon?”). action-icon (major): a visible action — or an item of a closed menu whose trigger is visible — labelled „Editează…” without icon-edit, or „Elimină… / Șterge…” without icon-delete (another icon counts as missing). action-icon-colour (major): that icon in another colour than the label. Exceptions: confirmation-dialog footers (library modal / FO confirm dialog have no footer icons), clear / dismiss controls that delete nothing (search ×, chip ×, file-item × = detach an attachment, the filter popover „Șterge” = clear the selection, „Șterge filtrele / căutarea / formatarea”).
_partAllow: v2 (2026-10-21, user: „use only our components”): a BEM part of a documented block is NOT accepted on its own any more (25,745 controls passed that way). A part passes when the part class itself is documented in the Component Inventory (short `__part` names resolve against the block of the same cell), when it is internal anatomy of a `product` root it sits in, or when it is listed here (selector + reason). Everything else = non-library-control.
_buttonPaint: v2 rule button-paint (major): a control (button, link, role=button, input type=button/submit, or a [tabindex=0] / [onclick] element) that paints like a button — a fill that differs from its background, a border on ≥ 3 sides or an inset ring, at a button size (20–64 high, ≤ 480 wide) with a radius ≥ 4 or side padding ≥ 8 — without the library `.btn`. Library primitives (spec.library) and form fields are never checked. Documented exceptions go in `allow` WITH a reason; a documented component is not an exception by itself (its button must be a `.btn`). `allowFamilies` = families whose canonical members paint by design (menu-item: the ONE dropdown item's hover / active fill); `stateSkip` = selected / current / open / focused controls (a state fill is not a button look — they are still checked by non-library-control).

_buttons: v2 rule button-size / button-icon-size (major): every visible `.btn` is 32 (Small), 40 (Medium) or 48 (Large) high; its own leading / trailing icon follows css/button-icons.css: 32 → 16, 40 / 48 → 20. `exempt` = library buttons with their own size; `iconExempt` = documented larger icons (phone pills / sheet ×). iconExempt: the phone facet-filter sort pill (48, icon 24 — css/facet-filter.css › phone toolbar, components.md „Facet filter · phone toolbar + sheets”).
_tags: v2 rule tag-size (major): tags are Small everywhere (user 2026-10-09 / 2026-10-15: 20 high, 12/16) — the library `.status-tag` and the BO Tag · Small `.e-permits-workplace__tag` (renderTag). exempt: `.e-permits-pd__world *` = the Process Designer canvas, drawn at the canvas zoom (one transform).
_desktopOnly: v2: states that only exist on desktop are SKIPPED on phone viewports (recorded as skipped, not as a demo error): Ghișeu (memory „Ghișeu desktop-only”: counter staff work on desktop), and the BO click paths whose nav target is hidden ≤ 960 (srv-, svc-10…, trf-) and the Process Designer canvas (pd-).
_pages: v2: pages without demo states, audited with no ?state= in --all / --pages (key `page:<file>`).
_interactions: v2 step „interactions”: per state the auditor clicks up to `maxTriggers` visible, distinct menu / drawer / disclosure triggers (and, on desktop, hovers `maxTooltips` tooltip triggers), finds the surface that opened (newly visible `surfaces`, or the trigger's aria-controls target), audits it with every rule, closes it (Escape, trigger again, else reloads the state). Findings carry `interaction`. --no-interactions turns it off.
_families: v2 rule converge (minor): ONE canonical implementation per pattern family. Runtime: every visible element of the family (`selector` and / or own class matching `classPattern`, restricted to `tags`) that is not inside a `canonical` (or an `allow` with its reason) is reported once per distinct class signature. Static (--static): every class defined in product CSS matching `static.pattern` that does not start with a canonical class. `menu-item` canonical also takes the item list of css/dropdown.css (the ONE dropdown item).

_static: v2 --static mode: reads product sources (js/, css/, cabinet-evo/, rap-evo/, the root HTML pages; never Components/* or css/main.css; demo-state files are tooling). Rules: library-restyle (a product CSS rule that restyles a library class: global = major, scoped = minor; allow-list = restyleAllowFiles / restyleAllow with reasons), hardcoded-colour (a hex / rgb / hsl literal outside a var() fallback: major when a Foundations token has exactly that value, else minor), private-token (product CSS redefines a token of css/main.css: major), private-palette (a product custom property holding a raw colour: minor), inline-svg-icon (an icon drawn with <path>/<circle>… instead of the sprite <use>: minor), role-button (role=button on a non-button element: major), native-title (title= on a button / link / role=button: minor), monospace (major, except monoAllow), converge (families › static). `internal` pages report every finding as minor.

fixHints.action-icon: „Editează…” carries the pen (icon-edit), every removal „Elimină… / Șterge…” the trash (icon-delete), before the label, in the button's colour: shell actionLabelHtml(label) / renderRowActions / renderStackMenu (they pick the icon from the label — actionIconFor), GEAPActRow / Cabinet menu items { icon: "icon-delete" }; hand-written buttons add Elimină (components.md › Action icons).
fixHints.action-icon-colour: the icon of a button / menu item is the label colour (fill: currentColor); never give the svg its own colour (components.md › Button).
fixHints.crumb-trail: Render the trail with the ONE library breadcrumb: GEAPBreadcrumbs.html(crumbs, { trailing }) (js/breadcrumbs.js) — shell renderBreadcrumbs / renderPageHeaderTop, CabEvo.pageHeader({ back }); delete the private markup and its CSS (components.md › Breadcrumb).
fixHints.back-link: The way back is the page header breadcrumb (desktop trail; phones the library .breadcrumbs--mobile „‹ parent”), never a custom „← Înapoi la …” link / button: give the parent crumb the existing back handler as `attr` (GEAPBreadcrumbs.html / renderBreadcrumbs) and delete the button and its CSS.
fixHints.copy-variant: Use GEAPCopyValue.html(value, { label }) (js/copy-value.js) — shell renderCopyCode / FO copyValueHtml / CabEvo.copyValueHtml already return it; delete the private markup and its CSS.
fixHints.copy-in-list: List views use the COMPACT copy value (no icon, the number itself copies, same wrap / tooltip / „Copiat”): shell renderListCode, act-row metaParts, GEAPCopyValue.html(value, { compact: true }). The icon variant belongs on profiles / headers / detail rows / dialogs.
fixHints.missing-copy: A number / code / IDNO in a list view is a compact copy value (user 2026-10-21: „in tables or stacked lists, no copy icon, but the behaviour is the same”): render it with shell renderListCode, act-row metaParts (number slot) or GEAPCopyValue.html(value, { compact: true, label }).
fixHints.non-library-control: use the library component (components.md › Component Inventory): .btn + variant + size, .chip, .checkbox, .radio, .switch, .search-input, .input / .e-permits-fo-input; a genuinely new control is first documented in components.md (inventory row + section) — ask the PO before inventing one
fixHints.field-height-phone: phones (≤760) use the library default field size = 48 (`.input` / `.search-input` default, FO fields via the ≤720 FO block that sets 48 + 16/24); never a fixed 40
fixHints.field-height-desktop: desktop uses the library medium size = 40 (`.input--medium`, `.search-input.medium`, FO fields 40)
fixHints.field-text-phone: phone field text = 16/24 (`--font-size-fs-16` / `--line-height-lh-24`; below 16 iOS zooms the page)
fixHints.field-icon-size: icons inside a field follow the library size for the field: 48 → 24 (`--icon-size-default`), 40 → 20 (`--icon-size-medium`), 32 → 16 (`--icon-size-small`)
fixHints.look-alike: styled like a control but not one: make it the library component (button.btn, a.link, .chip) or drop the control look
fixHints.button-paint: a control painted like a button is the library button: `<button class="btn btn-{primary|neutral|strict|secondary} btn-{sm|md|lg}">` (icon from css/button-icons.css); keep the product class only as a layout hook. A genuinely different control is first documented (components.md inventory row) AND listed with its reason in spec buttonPaint.allow — ask the PO first.
fixHints.button-size: library buttons are 32 (`.btn-sm`), 40 (`.btn-md`) or 48 (`.btn-lg` / no size class); never set a product height / padding on `.btn` — pick the size class.
fixHints.button-icon-size: the icon of a button comes from its size (css/button-icons.css): Small 16, Medium / Large 20 — drop `width` / `height` attributes and private icon sizes; documented larger icons go in spec buttons.iconExempt.
fixHints.tag-size: tags are Small everywhere: `status-tag status-tag--{tone} is-subtle status-tag--small` / renderTag (20 high, 12/16).
fixHints.clickable-non-control: a focusable / clickable element without a control role: put a real `<a>` / `<button>` inside (the documented stacked-row pattern: `.e-permits-stack__item.is-clickable` + a link / button) or give it the right role + keyboard handling.
fixHints.converge: one canonical implementation per pattern family (spec families): use the canonical component named in the finding and delete the private markup + CSS; if the private one is better, ask the PO to make it THE component (inventory row + spec canonical).
fixHints.library-restyle: do not restyle library classes in product CSS: use the library variant / size class; a deliberate product-wide rule lives in a documented contract file (spec static.restyleAllowFiles) or in restyleAllow with its reason.
fixHints.hardcoded-colour: colours are tokens: `var(--color-…, <fallback>)` (design-system.md); a value without a Foundations token is a PO question, shadows = `var(--shadow-…)`.
fixHints.private-token: never redefine a Foundations token in product CSS — use the token as is (or a product alias with another name that points to it).
fixHints.private-palette: no private colour palettes: point the variable at the Foundations token (`--x: var(--color-…)`) or use the token directly.
fixHints.inline-svg-icon: icons come from the sprite: `<svg class="icon"><use href="…#icon-name"></use></svg>`; a missing glyph is added to the sprite once.
fixHints.role-button: a clickable thing is a `<button type="button">` (or a link) — never `role=button` on a div / span / li.
fixHints.native-title: no native `title=` tooltips on controls: the library tooltip (`data-tooltip-label` + js/icon-tooltip.js) or a visible label.
fixHints.monospace: no monospace (memory „No monospace”): Onest everywhere; codes = neutral tag / copy value. Only rule-builder keywords `code.e-permits-doc-kw` are mono.
